name: Cristina Valenzuela
bio: Cristina Danielle Valenzuela (born July 11, 1987), known by her stage name Cristina Vee, is an American voice actress and voice director. She is known for The Mummy (2017), Star Wars: The Old Republic - Knights of the Fallen Empire (2015) and Helluva Boss.
